copy.title: CrimeMaps Germany
copy.caption: German police report maps · 14 cities
copy.note: Selected police announcements. They do not represent all crime.
copy.details: This is an early open-source version. Coverage, locations and translations may have gaps or errors. Please read the linked police announcements for context. Contributions are welcome.
copy.images: The city images were generated with AI using local landmarks. They introduce the cities and do not depict specific incidents.
copy.sourcesNote: POLIZEIKARTE is an independent project. The police links lead to the authorities responsible for each city.
copy.externalPoliceLabel: Open the police website for {city} (new window)
copy.githubPrivacy: To leave a message, sign in to GitHub. Your account and message are public. Do not include personal or sensitive information.
copy.analyticsCollection: GoatCounter counts page loads and reloads, excluding language changes and map operations. These are not unique visitors.
copy.analyticsOff: Visit collection is not enabled on this page.
copy.analyticsPrivacy: Country totals only. The connection IP is processed to estimate the country; individual pageviews, referrers and sessions are disabled.
copy.noticeProgress: The site is being improved. Announcement content is updated weekly; maps and nearby facilities (POIs) are updated monthly.
copy.noticeTranslation: GPT and Doubao Lite assist with translation. Chinese is the priority review version. English about 90% and German about 85% are project estimates, not results of a full accuracy assessment. Some details may still show the original text; check the source.
copy.noticeData: Selected police announcements and POLIZEIKARTE records retain source links. They are not a complete crime inventory; announcement totals are not counts of distinct offences.
copy.noticeMap: POI outlines and reference extents do not locate an incident. Darker symbols mark source-linked place types; nearby facilities are context and do not establish an offence at a business. Read other extents and colours in the legend. Unknown locations receive no invented coordinates.
copy.noticeMore: Sources, map legend and usage notes
